provenance.source: 14 Meshy GLBs supplied directly by the owner on 5 October 2026; originals read-only in Downloads
provenance.license: Owner-supplied project use; no blanket third-party open license is asserted. Do not redistribute unmodified originals by assumption.
provenance.derivatives: Original source silhouettes/materials studied; separately budgeted wood; source-derived clustered crown cards where dense foliage exceeds the budget; original procedural bark/frond palette for the two untextured palms.
provenance.copyrightReferences: No Gothic/Warcraft game data, art or code included.

preparation.UV: Source wood UV islands retained by collapse; original UV unwrap for two untextured palms; dense crowns use original-source spatial cluster atlas
preparation.material: Source wood PBR maps resized to 1024; dense foliage source albedo/alpha in a 2048 atlas; all-UV mild earthy PBR tint; rough nonmetal, no emission; original noise-baked palm albedo
preparation.semanticParts: UV albedo green-vs-bark classification plus protected low trunk; palm crown/radial mask for untextured sources; tiny disconnected upper Wood fragments returned to source Foliage. Inferred semantic boundary, not artist-authored labels.
preparation.geometry: uniform source normalization; separate wood/crown budgets; dense crowns use 21 source-positioned spatial clusters with 3 source-baked views, crossed curved side cards and curved top caps following each cluster vertical span; lower ornamental soil faces trimmed only for 1459/3106; residual source base retained in reserves
